inputs.text: That apology is a distraction, designed to make parents feel responsible while the people setting the agenda stay out of sight. More than 70 school positions are on the chopping block, and another “unavoidable” shortfall is being presented as if nobody made choices that led here. It looks like a pressure campaign: keep schools strained, then use the crisis to make cuts seem inevitable and discourage people from asking who benefits.
